summary: Trio Petroleum Canada, a wholly owned subsidiary of Trio Petroleum Corp, entered a Sept. 17, 2026 Farmout Agreement with Croverro Energy to earn working interests in Alberta and Saskatchewan oil and gas rights via up to seven earning programs, each drilling two test wells. Trio Canada must elect by Croverro's Oct. 1, 2026 notice and, if participating, pay a $450,000 prospect fee plus 100% of drilling, completion and equipping costs, initially earning 80% of Croverro's pre-earning interests until cost repayment, then 60%; non-participation terminates.
